content: Implemented jutsu-audio-model workspace crate with Project schema v1, strongly typed UUID IDs for project/assets/tracks/layers/clips/buses, metadata, assets, routing, typed parameters, and side-effect-free structured validation diagnostics. Linked Project Schema v1 document. TDD evidence: focused tests first failed on missing API and cross-track duplicate clip ID, then passed. Fresh validation: `cargo fmt --all -- --check` exit 0; `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` exit 0; `cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features` exit 0 with 7 passed, 0 failed. Dependencies serde 1.0.229, serde_json 1.0.151, uuid 1.24.0 verified as MIT OR Apache-2.0 / Apache-2.0 OR MIT. No commit or push.
